fields.name: BatchStep<TResult> batch-step extension contract
fields.contract: BatchStep<TResult> is an abstract batch-item extension boundary. A derived batch item must provide the protected-internal asynchronous execution operation, accepting the supplied shard identifier, database connection, transaction, connection name, provider services, logger, and cancellation token, and resolving a Task<TResult> for that execution context. The operation is unavailable as a public API.
